text.p: Banta Corp said Thursday that it and Dittler Brothers Inc terminated their discussions regarding Banta's acquisition of Dittler.
On November 4, 1996, the companies announced a letter of intent for the proposed acquisition. No reasons were given for ending the discussions.
Banta said it now plans to continue its share repurchase program. As previously announced, Banta's board authorized the repurchase of up to 1,500,000 shares of common stock.
Banta had discontinued the repurchases in light of its proposed acquisition of Dittler.
Prior to suspending repurchases, Banta had acquired 303,600 shares of its common stock under its repurchase program.

Banta Corp is involved in printing and digital imaging. It also offers global project management services, multimedia and software packages, interactive media, online services, point-of-purchase materials, and single-use products.
